items.title: Proposed Rules Regarding Foreign Ownership in Texas Still Pending
items.author: Ryan Reed
items.content: Rules for enforcing Texas' foreign ownership law are taking shape, and some industry groups have concerns.

items.title: Taking the Mobile Out of Manufactured Housing?
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: A change to federal law could enable the manufactured housing industry to play a bigger role in solving the affordability puzzle.
